**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching restriction on Teleglobe USA Inc. Full-text searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "personnel", "staff", "recruit" and "induce … to leave" (plus a combined regex sweep, validated against a control search) returned no hits, and the section outline contains no restrictive-covenant article — the operative covenants concern configuration, costs, capacity, O&M, default, assignment, confidentiality and disputes only.

That satisfies the preferred element ("Customer has no non-solicitation restriction"), so no redline was proposed. If the counterparty later seeks to add a personnel covenant, our fallback remains a mutual 12-month restriction limited to personnel directly involved, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
